descriptionChirho: General motion toward a reference point: to come, arrive, reach a destination; Arabic jaʾa/ataa, Korean 왔다/오다, Swahili -kuja/-fika.
Motion into an enclosed or bounded space: to enter, go into a house, city, tent, or territory; Arabic dakhala, Korean 들어갔다/들어왔다, Swahili -ingia.
Causative: to bring someone or something to a location, to fetch, carry, or deliver; Arabic ahdara, Korean 가져왔다/데려왔다, Swahili -leta.
Passive of the causative: to be brought, be carried in, be led into; Arabic majluub/mudkhal, Korean 들여보냈졌다, Swahili -letwa.
